info.cls_name: 商學進修一學位學程甲班
info.cls_ename: Continuing Education Bachelor's Program of Business

description.describe_ch: 本課程介紹經濟學與會計學原則及觀念，主要包括：生產與經濟成長、貨幣、物價、失業及金融市場、短期經濟波動與開放經濟的運作，瞭解政府政策及對穩定經濟活動的效果。以及會計學之應收帳款、存貨、長期性資產取得及折舊、公司會計、投資、負債、現金流量表及財務報表分析。
description.describe_eh: This course introduces the principles of Economics and Accountings. The main topics include economic production and growth, money, price level, unemployment, and financial market of an economy, short-term economic fluctuations and the open economy. Also, understand government policies and their stabilizing effects on economic activities. In addition, inventory, plant assets acquisition and depreciation, corporate accounting, investment, liabilities, statement of cash flows and financial statements analysis in Accounting.

targets.describe_ch: 能知道會計學與經濟學涵蓋的主要內容及描述現代企業的財務報表及其面臨的總體經濟環境。
targets.describe_en: Be able to know the main concepts of accounting and economics and describe the financial statements of modern enterprises and firms face the macroeconomic environment.

targets.describe_ch: 能理解經濟體系中各部門的行為與運作與會計學原理的情況。
targets.describe_en: Able to understand the behavior of economic sectors and the operation of accountings.

targets.describe_ch: 應用經濟體系的總合供給及總合需求，分析短期經濟波動與會計學原理之應用。
targets.describe_en: Applying the aggregate supply and aggregate demand of an economy to analyze the short-run economic fluctuations and applying principle of accountings.
